page_title: NOT 1-3 NEW | Nottingham Forest v Newcastle 10/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+8' Alexander Isak goes off the pitch and William Osula (Newcastle Utd) comes on.
90+7' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) decides to keep the ball to himself and weaves through the defence into the box. From there he takes a shot which goes narrowly wide of the target.
90+5' Anthony Taylor interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Elliot Anderson (Nottingham).

90+3' What a great effort! Murillo (Nottingham) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches over the crossbar. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
90+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nottingham.
90+1' Ola Aina (Nottingham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Nottingham get a corner.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Anthony Taylor has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ryan Yates (Nottingham).
88' Here comes a substitution. James Ward-Prowse (Nottingham) is brought on as a substitute for Alex Moreno.
88' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to substitute Anthony Elanga and he is replaced by Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham).
87' Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block.
85' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) sends a cross into the box, but Nick Pope comes off his line to gather the ball.

83' 1 - 3 Sandro Tonali feeds the ball through to Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 1:3!
81' Ramon Sosa (Nottingham) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Anthony Taylor saw the whole situation.
80' Eddie Howe is forced to make a change. Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is unable to continue due to injury, Harvey Barnes comes on.
79' The game is interrupted now, Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
79' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the left post.

77' What a poor attempt! Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes yards wide of the left post.
77' The attendance is 30145.
74' It will be a substitution. Ramon Sosa (Nottingham) is ready to enter the pitch as Nicolas Dominguez walks off.
72' 1 - 2 Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) makes himself some space on the edge of the penalty area and pulls the trigger. His accurate effort goes in off the left post and the score changes to 1:2.
70' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
69' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) comes onto the pitch so that Joe Willock can be given a rest.

68' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) comes close to scoring. He peels away from his marker and gets on the end of a cross from Joe Willock, but he hits a shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
68' The free kick is delivered by Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
67' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) trips an opposition player and Anthony Taylor signals a foul.
66' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Matz Sels intercepts the ball.
65' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
62' Dangerous play by Ryan Yates (Nottingham). Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
61' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
61' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) prepares to take a corner kick.
61' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. It will be a corner kick for Nottingham.
59' Here is a change. Callum Hudson-Odoi is going off and Nuno Espirito Santo gives the last tactical orders to Jota Silva (Nottingham).
59' Here comes a substitution. Morgan Gibbs-White is given a rest as he is replaced by Elliot Anderson (Nottingham).
56' Referee Anthony Taylor points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) goes wild in celebration.
56' Wait! Referee Anthony Taylor has indicated he is going to review the Newcastle goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.

54' 1 - 1 Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) is the first to get to a rebound inside the penalty area and his weak, but precise effort finds its way low into the back of the net, bouncing in off the right post.
54' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) will take the corner.
52' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) is able to continue to play.
51' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

50' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
50' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) serves up a nice cross, but Matz Sels punches the ball away.
49' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) tries to find Alexander Isak, but he puts too much power on the pass.
48' Newcastle seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The whistle blows and Anthony Taylor starts the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
43' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
41' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) on the edge of the box.
40' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul after Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) hacks down one of his opponents. Newcastle earn a free kick.

38' Anthony Elanga bends the corner in towards the goal and finds Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) almost on the goal line, but he somehow contrives to head the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
38' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
37' Alex Moreno (Nottingham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Nottingham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
33' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Matz Sels is alert and denies him with a nice save.
33' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) will take a corner kick.
31' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

29' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) leaps high deep inside the box to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick and attempts to score with a header. His effort is not accurate at all and goes well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.

29' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Anthony Taylor has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Newcastle.
28' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
27' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Newcastle.
25' Newcastle take a short corner kick.

24' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) receives an accurate pass and finds some space for a shot. The keeper is prepared and denies his long-range effort towards the left post. Brilliant save! Now Newcastle have a corner.

22' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Anthony Elanga flights the free kick into the box, where Murillo (Nottingham) peels off his marker and heads it low into the centre of the goal from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 1:0.

21' It looks like Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) saw red with that tackle. Anthony Taylor won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Free kick. Nottingham will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
21' A dangerous looking corner kick from Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) is cleared to safety by the defence.

20' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Ryan Yates (Nottingham) inside the box. He lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Nick Pope was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save. The referee signals a corner kick to Nottingham.

17' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) darts into the box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He produces a poor shot which goes well over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
15' The Nottingham players are exchanging some short passes.
12' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
11' Anthony Taylor blows for a foul after Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
11' The Newcastle players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
9' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
8' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
7' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Anthony Taylor had an easy-decision to make.
6' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
5' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) was too forceful with his tackle and Anthony Taylor interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
4' There's an opportunity for Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
4' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Newcastle have a corner.
4' Newcastle are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
2' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Nottingham was in an offside position.
1' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle. Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul after dangerous play. Nottingham are awarded the free kick.
1' The first half has started.
Nottingham will kick the game off.
The match will be delayed due to ceremony.
Anthony Taylor is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
